最初は「GitHubの31リポジトリを正(Source of Truth)として:
Initially, the plan was to create a "catalog site that automatically synchronizes metadata using GitHub's 31 repositories as the source of truth."
However, I realized that this was a direction in which I would not be able to experience the thrill of creating software.
目的は完成品の紹介ではなく、ソフトウェアで問題を解決するアプローチ・プロセスを伝:
The purpose is not to introduce finished products, but to convey the approach and process of solving problems with software, and to find people who think the same way.
Therefore, the main focus of the site will be changed from a ``project catalog'' to a ``list of essays that describe the thinking process.''
**旧**: GitHub(主役・データソース) → 自動同期 → カタログサイ: **Old**: GitHub (main character/data source) → Automatic synchronization → Catalog site
**新**: 思考の過程 → エッセイ(主役) → サイト ⇢ GitHub(脇: **New**: Thought process → Essay (main role) → Site ⇢ GitHub (supporting role/result storage)
GitHub側の自動化(GitHub Actions、projects.json: Automation on the GitHub side (GitHub Actions, projects.json synchronization) is no longer needed, so it will be removed from the plan.
**トップページ** = エッセイの一覧(日付順): **Top page** = List of essays (ordered by date)
**各エッセイページ** = 1つの思考プロセスの記録: **Each essay page** = record of one thought process
GitHubリンクは各エッセイの末尾に控えめに添えるのみ(脚注的な扱い): GitHub links are only added sparingly at the end of each essay (treated as a footnote).
カード+サムネイル+タグでフィルタする「カタログ」的なUIは廃止し、文章中心のレ: The "catalog"-like UI that filters by card + thumbnail + tag will be abolished, and the layout will focus on text.
結果は地味でいい。完成・成功で終わる必要はない。未解決のまま終わるエッセイも歓迎: The results are modest. It doesn't have to end with completion or success. Essays that remain unresolved are also welcome.
GitHubリンクは最後に小さく。本文の主役は思考であって、コードではない。: GitHub link is small at the end. The main character of the text is thought, not code.
動画解説がある場合は本文中(該当する転換点)に埋め込んでよい。文字起こしはしない: If there is a video explanation, it may be embedded in the text (at the relevant turning point). I won't transcribe it.
日記にならないように、4段構成(始めた/違った/転換/結果)を崩さない。時系列の: In order to avoid turning it into a diary, I will not break down the four-stage structure (start/different/change/result). Do not create a chronological work log.
書く対象の選び方: How to choose what to write about
全プロジェクトにエッセイが要るわけではない。「方針転換があった」「思っていたのと: Not every project requires an essay. Write about projects where there was a change in policy or a discovery that was different from what I had expected. If something is simply ``made and finished'' and has no turning point, don't force it into an essay.
GitHub側の最小ルール(維持する部分): Minimum rules on GitHub side (part to maintain)
カタログ計画からはこの2点だけ残す。エッセイにストーリーを書く分、README側: Only these two items will remain from the catalog plan. Since you are writing the story in your essay, the README should be light.
修正履歴・進捗・タスクリストは引き続き書かない(GitHubのコミット履歴で十分: I will not continue to write revision history, progress, or task lists (as GitHub's commit history is sufficient).
全リポジトリ共通でMIT。Apache等のライブラリを依存関係として使う分には問: MIT common to all repositories. There is no problem when using libraries such as Apache as dependencies (separate from the license of your own code).
Topics(タグ)・projects.json・GitHub Actions自: Automating Topics (tags), projects.json, and GitHub Actions is unnecessary for the time being (lower priority).
サイトリポジトリ(html)内にMarkdownファイルとして直接書く。: Write directly as a Markdown file in the site repository (html).
ファイル名は __CODE_PH_0__ で統一。自動生成の仕組みは不要なので、: The file name is unified as __CODE_PH_0__. There is no need for an automatic generation mechanism, so you can simply increase the number by hand.
これまでに方針転換があったプロジェクトを思い出す(まずは SekkaTi or: I remember a project that had a change of direction (starting with SekkaTi or this portfolio itself)
1本書いてみる(このガイドのテンプレートに沿って): 1 Write a book (following the template in this guide)
サイトのトップページをエッセイ一覧に変更する(既存のカード一覧UIをベースに転用: Change the top page of the site to an essay list (can be repurposed based on the existing card list UI)
並行して、LICENSE(MIT)だけは全リポジトリに淡々と追加していく: In parallel, only LICENSE (MIT) is added to all repositories.

AI tries to understand this and tends to choose affirmative responses. Especially when it comes to creative works or personal writing, the AI ​​is wary of the risk that criticism will be perceived as a denial of one's character, and chooses compliments as a safety measure.

The problem is that AI tends to issue these ``affirmations with evidence'' and ``affirmations with weak evidence'' without distinguishing between them, making it difficult for the receiver to tell them apart.
だからこそ、受け手に問い直す姿勢が要る: That's why we need an attitude of questioning the receiver.
結論としては、「改善点があるから褒める」のではなく、「改善点の有無にかかわらず、: In conclusion, rather than ``praising something because there are areas for improvement,'' the reality is that ``AI tends to give positive words regardless of whether or not there are areas for improvement.''
だとすれば、褒められた側がやるべきことは自ずと決まってくる。: If this is the case, what the person receiving the praise should do will be determined automatically.
まず、褒め言葉を額面通り受け取らないこと。その評価が別の全く違う文章にも当てはま: First, don't take compliments at face value. If that evaluation also applies to another completely different text, there is a high possibility that there is no substance to it.
次に、能動的に問い直すこと。「具体的にどこが良いのか」「弱点や改善点は」とセット: Next, actively ask questions. ドーナツの中で考えたこと ―― 初めてのMRI体験記: What I thought inside the donut -- My first MRI experience
今日、MRI検査を受けてきた。\nきっかけは大した話ではない。最近ちょっと気にな:
I had an MRI scan today.
The reason is not a big deal. I recently had some symptoms that I was concerned about, and when I consulted my family doctor, he said, ``I'd like to take some pictures just in case,'' and an appointment was scheduled. There is no word that stirs my imagination as much as the word "just in case." It's just my nature to find myself in the waiting room, clutching my smartphone, typing into the search box, ``Are there any differences between manufacturers?''
そして調べているうちに、思いのほか奥が深い世界だと知ることになった。: As I researched it, I discovered that it was a much deeper world than I had expected.
「ドーナツ」にもいろいろある: There are many types of donuts
MRIといえば、あの筒状の装置に頭から吸い込まれていくイメージしかなかった。実際: When I thought of MRI, all I could think of was my head being sucked into that cylindrical machine. In fact, that's exactly what I entered today, and as someone who is claustrophobic myself, I was honestly quite prepared.
ところが調べてみると、あの「筒型」は世界の主要メーカーが競い合う技術のほんの一側: However, upon investigation, it appears that the ``cylindrical shape'' is just one aspect of the technology in which the world's major manufacturers are competing. Overseas companies such as Siemens, GE, and Philips are competing with each other by focusing on image quality and imaging speed. In particular, Siemens is said to be able to achieve both high-definition images and time savings through AI-based image reconstruction, so it's no wonder that it is so useful at university hospitals and research institutes. GE uses an ``AIR coil,'' a coil that is as soft as a blanket, and seems to be aiming to reduce the burden on the body. Philips seems to even have a device called ``Ambient Experience'' that creates a relaxing space in the examination room itself with images and lighting. I think I'll look for a facility like that the next time I have an MRI.
一方で国産勢は、また違うアプローチを取っている。キヤノンメディカルシステムズは「: Domestic manufacturers, on the other hand, are taking a different approach. As the name ``Pianissimo'' suggests, Canon Medical Systems sells its silent technology that thoroughly suppresses impact sounds similar to those found at construction sites, and aims to achieve high image quality even in low magnetic fields through noise reduction using AI. Fujifilm Healthcare is even more interesting and says it is a pioneer in "open MRI," which does not fit into a tube. It is a type that can be inserted from the top and bottom, making it suitable for people with claustrophobia, children, and the elderly. If I had gone to a Fujifilm facility today, I might not have felt that unique feeling of pressure.
静かさは正義だと知った日: The day I learned that silence is justice
実際に検査を受けてみて一番驚いたのは、あの「音」だった。ゴンゴンゴン、ガガガガと: What surprised me the most when I actually took the test was that "sound." Although I had been told in advance that the intermittent banging sound would be loud, it was louder than I expected. It felt like someone was doing construction right next to my ears, and the music playing through the headphones I was provided with didn't make much sense.
この体験から、キヤノンの「Pianissimo」という静音技術の話がやけに刺さっ: From this experience, the story of Canon's silent technology called ``Pianissimo'' really stuck with me. If that sound can be significantly suppressed, that alone should lower the psychological hurdles for testing. Because of my job as an engineer, I tended to focus on performance and precision, but when I lay there as a patient, I realized that ``quietness'' is the most tangible value. I feel like I was reminded once again that the essence of technology is something that cannot be measured just by the numbers on a spec sheet.
メーカーの違いは、結局「誰のための設計か」: The difference between manufacturers is ultimately "who is it designed for?"
今回調べて面白かったのは、各社の強みが単純な性能競争になっていないことだ。海外勢: What I found interesting in this research is that the strengths of each company are not simply a performance competition. Overseas companies are competing in different arenas, with image quality, research, and cutting-edge technology as the core, while domestic manufacturers are competing in quietness, ease of installation, and generous support. It is interesting that it is not just the machine that determines the image quality, as it is said that not only the physical specifications such as whether the magnetic field strength is 1.5T or 3.0T, but also the skill of the technician in charge of the inspection influences the image quality.
検査を終えたあと、気になって病院のウェブサイトを覗いてみたら、思わぬ収穫があった: After completing the test, I got curious and looked at the hospital's website, and found something unexpected. This hospital had three MRI machines, all made by Siemens.
同じ「MAGNETOM」シリーズという名前を背負いながら、導入時期は2024年ま: Although bearing the same name as the "MAGNETOM" series, the introduction period is a total of 16 years until 2024. The latest Vida is probably loaded with cutting-edge AI technology like the aforementioned Deep Resolve, while the Avantos are veterans who continue to be active despite repeated improvements.
問題は、自分が今日どの機体に入ったのか、まったく見当がつかないという点だ。カルテ: The problem is that I have no idea which aircraft I'm in today. When I looked back at the medical record, I didn't even have the model name written down, and I didn't have time to ask about it during the examination. Next time I have a chance to take one, I think I'll ask the technician in charge, ``Is this Vida?'' to ease my fears. You might think I'm an unusual patient.
結果は全く異常なし、爆音にも関わらず寝てしまった。不安なときほど、 関係のない: There were no abnormalities at all, and I fell asleep despite the loud noise. It may be an occupational disease for engineers that the more anxious they are, the more they investigate unrelated matters. On the other hand, some of me seem to be able to get a good night's sleep only during those times.
次にMRIを受ける機会があったら、その時はぜひ静音技術自慢のメーカーの機械で挑み: The next time I have the opportunity to undergo an MRI, I would definitely like to use a machine from a manufacturer that prides itself on its silent technology.

楽天に無い、あるいは選択肢が乏しい商品は、YahooとAmazonを比較して安い: For products that are not available on Rakuten or for which there are few options, compare Yahoo and Amazon and choose the cheaper one.

例の認証という儀式: An example of the ritual of authentication
SwitchBotのAPIはHMAC-SHA256による署名付きリクエストを要求: SwitchBot's API requires HMAC-SHA256 signed requests. I followed the same ritual last time when I implemented it on ESP32, but this time I will implement it on the Android (Kotlin) side. The process remains the same, combining a millisecond-accurate timestamp with a random nonce to generate the signature. The implementation itself is not difficult, but it can be a bit nerve-wracking since it immediately returns a 401 if even one value is off.

UIはカード型のデザインを採用した。デバイスの種類（ボット、プラグ、エアコン、テ: The UI uses a card-type design. A dedicated control panel changes depending on the type of device (bot, plug, air conditioner, TV, etc.), and only the necessary controls are displayed for each device. For an air conditioner, you can adjust the temperature and turn off the button; for a TV, you can simply set the channel, volume, and power; and for a bot or plug, simply turn it on and off. Registered scenes can also be executed with one tap.
API TokenとSecretはアプリ内の設定ダイアログから登録・更新でき、端: API Token and Secret can be registered and updated from the in-app settings dialog and are saved in the device's DataStore. Troublesome settings only need to be done once.

ハイブリッド車を今更ですがまとめてみた: I've put together a summary of hybrid cars.
最近、トヨタ・スバル・マツダが「次世代エンジン」について合同で発表会をやったニュ: Recently, when I saw the news that Toyota, Subaru, and Mazda held a joint presentation about their next-generation engine, I suddenly thought about this. Although they are all collectively referred to as "hybrid," each company actually has completely different systems.
普段クルマのカタログを見ていても「THS」とか「e-POWER」とか「IMA」と: Even if you look at a car catalog, you'll just see a bunch of mysterious abbreviations like "THS", "e-POWER", and "IMA", and to be honest, I think most people just think, "Well, it's a combination of electricity and gasoline, right?" I had a similar experience. But when you look inside, it's quite profound.
というわけで今回は、エンジニアじゃない人にも伝わるように、ハイブリッドの3つの方: So this time, I would like to break down and introduce the three hybrid methods so that even non-engineers can understand them.
そもそも、なんで方式が分かれるのか: First of all, why are there different methods?
答えはシンプルで、「お金」と「割り切り」の問題だ。: The answer is simple: it's a question of money and division.
新しい仕組みを一から作るのはコストがかかる。だから各メーカーは、自分たちの得意分: Creating a new system from scratch is expensive. Therefore, each manufacturer has chosen a different path depending on their field of expertise and how to utilize the parts (engines and transmissions) they have made in the past. As a result, it is divided into three methods.
3つの方式を、なるべく平たく説明する: Explain the three methods as simply as possible
| 方式 | 代表例 | ざっくり言うと | 得意なこと | 苦手なこと |\n:
| Method | Typical example | Roughly speaking | What we are good at | What we are weak at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Series method | Nissan e-POWER | The engine specializes in power generation, only the motor runs | The pleasant feeling of acceleration that only a motor can provide | Efficiency decreases as the speed range increases, such as on highways |
| Parallel system | Honda IMA, European 48V mild, etc. | The engine is the main character, the motor is a helper | The existing transmission can be used as is, so it can be made cheaply | The scope for improving fuel efficiency is limited |
| Split system | Toyota THS | Automatically divides engine power into "power generation" and "driving" | High efficiency in all speed ranges and good fuel efficiency | The mechanism is complex and costly |
一つずつ、もう少しかみ砕いてみる。: Try chewing on each one a little more.
シリーズ方式 = 「発電機を積んだEV」: Series method = “EV loaded with a generator”
日産のe-POWERがこれ。エンジンは一切タイヤを回さない。ひたすら発電だけに専: This is Nissan's e-POWER. The engine does not turn the tires at all. The system is such that the motor is solely responsible for generating electricity, and the only thing that actually makes the car run is the motor.
だから乗り味は限りなくEVに近い。アクセルを踏んだ瞬間のスッとした加速感は、この: Therefore, the ride quality is very close to that of an EV. The smooth feeling of acceleration the moment you step on the accelerator is a weapon unique to this system. However, when cruising at a constant high speed, such as on a highway, it has the disadvantage that losses tend to occur in the conversion process from engine to power generation to motor.
パラレル方式 = 「エンジンが主役、モーターは助っ人」: Parallel system = "Engine is the main character, motor is a helper"
ホンダのIMAや、欧州でよく見る48Vのマイルドハイブリッドがこのタイプ。基本は: This type is Honda's IMA and the 48V mild hybrid often seen in Europe. The basic relationship is that the engine runs the vehicle, and the motor provides a little help when accelerating or going up hills.
このやり方の一番のメリットは、今まで使っていたトランスミッション(変速機)をその: The biggest advantage of this method is that you can use the transmission you've been using as is. Since there is no need to create a new product, development costs can be reduced. It is a realistic option that is suitable when you want to achieve a moderate fuel efficiency improvement at the lowest possible price.
スプリット方式 = 「発電と走行を同時に、自在に配分」: Split method = "Freely distribute power generation and driving at the same time"
トヨタのTHSがこの代表格。「動力分割機構」という遊星ギアの仕組みを使って、エン: Toyota's THS is a typical example of this. Using a planetary gear mechanism called a "power splitting mechanism," the engine's power is automatically distributed between "for power generation" and "for turning the tires" depending on the situation.
これによって、シリーズ方式のいいところ(モーターらしい走り)と、パラレル方式のい: This allows the advantages of the series system (running like a motor) and the advantages of the parallel system (high efficiency of running directly with the engine) to be used depending on the situation. It is often explained as ``there is no transmission,'' but to be precise, there is simply no physical transmission; in fact, very precise control is performed inside using a motor and gears. As a result, the structure becomes more complicated and the cost increases.
トヨタの技術、スバルはどう料理したか: Toyota's technology, how did Subaru cook it?
面白いのが、スバルの新型ハイブリッドの話だ。スバルはトヨタのTHSという仕組みを: An interesting story is Subaru's new hybrid. Although Subaru uses Toyota's THS system, it stubbornly maintains its company's traditions of ``horizontally opposed engines'' and ``four-wheel drive (symmetrical AWD) that is mechanically connected to the rear wheels.''
本来THSは横置きのエンジン向けに作られた仕組みなのに、スバルは縦置きレイアウト: Although THS was originally designed for horizontally mounted engines, Subaru rearranged it into a vertically mounted layout. Moreover, due to the structure of the THS, there is no "back gear", so the only way to go backwards is to rotate the motor in the opposite direction. Therefore, Subaru went so far as to significantly increase the motor's maximum torque in order to pass the harsh reverse test on hills.
さらにガソリンタンクを大きくして「一回の給油で1000km以上走れる」ことを売り: Furthermore, it is interesting to note that the gasoline tank has been enlarged to promote the ability to drive over 1,000 km on a single refueling, and the finishing style is more like a Subaru that emphasizes reliability and tradition, which is different from an efficiency-oriented Toyota.
で、結局どれがいいの?: So, in the end, which one is better?
優劣というより、「何を優先するか」の違いだと思う。: Rather than being superior or inferior, I think the difference lies in what you prioritize.
とにかく燃費と実績を求めるなら → スプリット方式(トヨタ系): If you are looking for fuel efficiency and performance, use the split method (Toyota type)
ブランドらしさや機械的な信頼性を守りたいなら → スバルのような独自解釈: If you want to maintain brand identity and mechanical reliability → Unique interpretation like Subaru
早く・安く電動化したいなら → パラレル方式: If you want to electrify quickly and cheaply → Parallel method
同じ「ハイブリッド」という言葉の中に、これだけ違う考え方が詰まっている。次にハイ: The word "hybrid" contains so many different ideas. I think the next time I look at a hybrid car catalog, I'll look at it a little differently.

ディスプレイの主要な3つの技術——QD-OLED、Mini LED、および従来の: This memorandum summarizes the mechanisms, advantages, disadvantages, and suitability for each application of the three main display technologies: QD-OLED, Mini LED, and conventional organic EL (OLED).
QD-OLEDは、有機ELの「漆黒」と量子ドット（QD）の「鮮やかな発色」を融合: QD-OLED is a hybrid technology that combines the jet black of organic EL and the vivid color of quantum dots (QD), providing the highest level of visual experience available at the moment.
Mini LEDは、従来の液晶ディスプレイ（LCD）のバックライトを極小化し、エ: Mini LED is a technology that significantly improves the ``black floating'', a weak point of LCDs, by minimizing the backlight of conventional liquid crystal displays (LCDs) and controlling it separately for each area (local dimming).
従来の有機EL（OLED）は、完全な黒と無限のコントラスト、優れた応答速度を誇る: Conventional organic EL (OLED) boasts perfect black, infinite contrast, and excellent response speed, but the challenge is balancing high brightness with burn-in risk.
選択の鍵は「視聴環境」と「用途」にある。明るいリビングや長時間視聴にはMini: The key to selection lies in the ``viewing environment'' and ``purpose.'' Mini LED is suitable for bright living rooms and long viewing periods, while QD-OLED and organic EL are ideal for watching movies and high-end gaming experiences that emphasize immersion.
QD-OLEDは、Samsung Displayが開発した次世代の自発光ディスプ: QD-OLED is the next generation self-emissive display technology developed by Samsung Display.
従来の有機EL（多くは白色OLEDにカラーフィルターを使用する方式）とは異なり、: Unlike conventional organic ELs (mostly white OLEDs with color filters), they use blue organic ELs as the light source.
波長変換： 青色OLEDの光を量子ドット（Quantum Dot）層に透過させ、: Wavelength conversion: Blue OLED light is transmitted through a quantum dot layer and converted into highly pure red (R) and green (G).
RGB生成： フィルターで光を遮るのではなく、光の粒子そのものを変換するため、光: RGB generation: Rather than blocking light with a filter, it converts the light particles themselves, resulting in extremely low light loss and high energy efficiency.
圧倒的な色表現： 量子ドットにより、特に赤と緑の発色が豊かで、従来のOLEDより: Overwhelming color expression: Quantum dots produce particularly rich red and green colors, achieving a wider color gamut that is more vivid than conventional OLEDs.

車を選ぶとき、人はだいたい二つの顔を思い浮かべる。休日にアウトドアへ繰り出す自分: When choosing a car, people usually have two faces in mind. I go outdoors on holidays, and I go shopping at the supermarket on weekdays. The trouble is, these two want completely different cars.
SUVは頼もしい。最低地上高が高く、4WDなら雪の轍だってなんとかしてくれる。轍: SUVs are reliable. The ground clearance is high, and with 4WD, it can handle even snowy ruts. Even if the tires get lost in a rut, they won't scratch the bottom of the car, and the traction can be distributed between the front and rear wheels, giving you a sense of security on snowy roads. Many car models come standard with roof rails, allowing luggage that does not fit inside the car to escape onto the roof. Being able to earn a payload of ``inside the car + on top of the car'' is quite strong.
一方、ミニバンはとにかく懐が深い。3列シートを畳めばフラットで広大な荷室が出現し: On the other hand, minivans are very popular. Fold the third row of seats to reveal a spacious, flat cargo area, with plenty of room even if you throw in a tent, tarp, table, chairs, and cooler box all at once. If you have a family of four or more, the loading capacity and ease of getting in and out (sliding doors, low floor) will be an overwhelming asset. This is especially true when children are young.
そしてコンパクトカーは、地味だが誠実な選択肢だ。取り回しが良く、狭い山道や住宅街: And compact cars are a humble but honest option. It is easy to maneuver and can be used on narrow mountain roads and parking lots in residential areas without worrying. It has good fuel efficiency, and reduces vehicle price and maintenance costs. Thanks to VSC (side skid prevention system), skidding and spins on unpaved roads and muddy roads are now considerably suppressed. However, this only assumes that the tires can grip the road surface. If the tires get completely stuck in a deep rut and start spinning, no matter how good the VSC is, it won't solve the physical problem of not being able to move. This is the decisive difference between it and an SUV.
結局どれがいいのか: Which one is better after all?
結局のところ、どれが正解かは車のスペック表だけでは決まらない。決め手になるのは、: In the end, the correct answer cannot be determined just by looking at the car's spec sheet. The deciding factors are always four axes.
一つ目は人数。家族が2人でたまにアウトドアという程度なら、コンパクトカーでも後席: The first is the number of people. If you have a family of two and only occasionally go outdoors, you can get by in a compact car by folding down the rear seats. However, if four or more people are seriously loading luggage, the story changes.
二つ目はアウトドアの頻度と本気度。月に1〜2回程度のお出かけなら、普段使いの負担: The second factor is the frequency and seriousness of outdoor activities. If you only go out once or twice a month, a compact car is an overall good deal because it reduces the burden of everyday use. On the other hand, if you frequently travel to really bad roads or snowy areas, you will benefit greatly from an SUV or minivan, even if you sacrifice some of the usual fuel efficiency and maneuverability.
三つ目は普段使いの比重。通勤や買い物がメインで、アウトドアは「たまに」の位置づけ: The third one is the specific gravity for everyday use. If your main purpose is commuting or shopping, and you only go outdoors once in a while, the fuel efficiency and ease of handling will be more beneficial in everyday situations.
四つ目は悪路・積雪の有無。ここだけはコンパクトカーもミニバンも、SUVの牙城を崩: The fourth factor is the presence or absence of bad roads and snow. Without third-party certification, you cannot even write "organic" or "organic" on the package. 一括変換自体はあっさり動いたのだが、レビューしてみると、いくつか課題が出てきた。: The batch conversion itself worked easily, but when I reviewed it, I found some issues.
やってみて分かったこと: What I learned after trying it
**リンクのズレ。** スクリプトは URL の先頭に __CODE_PH_0_: **Link misalignment. ** The script does not have a process to insert __CODE_PH_0__ at the beginning of the URL. If I tried to rewrite the links on all pages mechanically, it would probably become chaotic, so I decided to do it manually.
**画像の中の日本語。** 意外と盲点だったのが、画像ファイルの中に日本語テキス: **Japanese in the image. ** A surprising blind spot was the case where the image file contained Japanese text. Scripts can only translate text, so of course they can't access the contents of images. If you want to seriously support multiple languages, I feel that this is an important point to consider from the beginning.
**「」内の変換漏れ。** 鉤括弧で囲んだ部分がそのまま残るケースが数件あった。: **Missing the conversion in "". ** In several cases, the part enclosed in square brackets was left intact. Apparently this is a specification of Google Translate. It would be a good idea to be aware of how to use parentheses when writing the material.
**直訳の不自然さ。** 日本語特有の主語省略をそのまま英訳すると、誰の話か分か: **Unnatural literal translation. ** If you translate subject omission, which is unique to Japanese, into English, you will end up with a sentence in which it is difficult to tell who is speaking. "I think..." is sometimes written as __CODE_PH_0__, but depending on the context, __CODE_PH_1__ is more natural. If you want to properly convey the nuances, you need to correct this with a human eye.
**sitemap.xml。** 多言語サイトであることを検索エンジンに伝えるに: **sitemap.xml. ** To tell search engines that your site is multilingual, you need to write the Japanese and English versions as a pair in __CODE_PH_0__.

古いスマホを登山用GPSロガーにした: I turned my old smartphone into a GPS logger for mountain climbing.
メイン端末のバッテリーを守るために: To protect the main terminal battery
山に入るとき、メインで使っているスマホのバッテリーはできる限り温存しておきたい。: When going into the mountains, I want to conserve the battery of my main smartphone as much as possible. This is because I want to avoid unnecessary wear and tear because I use it for contacting people or checking maps in case of an emergency. But at the same time, I also want to keep a log of my walking path.
既存のアプリや活動記録サービスもあるが、多機能ゆえにバッテリーを食いすぎたり、画: There are existing apps and activity tracking services, but because of their multiple functions, they eat up too much battery and the screen is too busy. What I want is a simple mechanism that only retrieves location information once a minute and saves it in KML format.
それなら、引き出しで眠っている古いスマホに専用のGPSロガーとして働いてもらえば: Then you can turn your old smartphone sitting in your drawer into a dedicated GPS logger.
複雑なロジックは何ひとつない。1分周期でGPS座標を追加するだけなので、Andr: There's no complicated logic whatsoever. Since I only need to add GPS coordinates every minute, I decided to quickly create one myself using Android Studio and AI assistant.
重視したのは以下のポイントだ。: We focused on the following points.
**省電力設計**: 位置情報の取得間隔はデフォルトで1分。無駄な測位を極力抑え: **Power saving design**: Location information acquisition interval is 1 minute by default. Unnecessary positioning has been minimized and screen display has been minimized.
**バックグラウンド記録**: フォアグラウンドサービスとして動作させ、画面オフ: **Background recording**: Runs as a foreground service, ensuring recording continues even when the screen is off or the app is in the background.
**イベント即時記録**: 「開始」「一時停止」「再開」「停止」のボタン操作を行: **Immediate event recording**: The coordinates at the moment you press the "Start", "Pause", "Resume", or "Stop" buttons are recorded immediately without waiting for a 1-minute interval.
**KML形式での出力**: 保存されるデータは標準的なKML形式。PCに取り込: **Output in KML format**: Data saved is in standard KML format. It is also easy to import it to your PC and look back on your travel route.
**リアルタイム表示と名前のカスタマイズ**: 画面上で取得座標やステータスをリ: **Real-time display and name customization**: Acquired coordinates and status can be checked in real time on the screen, and the file name can be changed from the default start date and time.
メイン端末のバッテリー残量にハラハラしながらログをとるくらいなら、役割を終えた旧: It's much better for your mental health to let your old device take on a second life as a single-function logger, rather than fretting over the remaining battery life of your main device while taking logs.
山歩きの供として、これから静かに動いてもらう予定だ。: We plan to have it move quietly as a companion while hiking in the mountains.
